column1: # Hand-written replacements of the game's shaders on the D3D9 path (nx_render --native, the parity runs), keyed by
# the original's file name in the player's shader package. Never keyed by hash: tools/native_dir.py resolves the
# names in the player's packages locally. Columns: original, native shader (build.py name.stage), the constant
# table it assumes (Name@register[xcount]; native_dir.py refuses a program whose table differs).
